'''Rockhowler''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|Rockhowlers can live in the natural wilderness. These intelligent yet mischievous creatures often prepare "traps" and "dangers" for hapless travelers. They seem to enjoy the sight of humans frustrated by their antics. Please deal with them patiently.}}
